	We are seeking a skilled and proactive Electrical Engineer to support the maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and installation of electrical, automation, and instrumentation systems within our processing operations.

	Practical knowledge of industrial motor controls, pump drives, generators, VFDs, soft starters, and control systems.
	Good understanding of electrical safety standards and procedures.

N160,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Ascentech brings expertise across borders, backed by over 13 years of dedicated experience in delivering practical HR and recruitment solutions.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Electrical Engineer 

Job Location: Kano 
Business Unit: Sesame – Processing

About the Role


	We are seeking a skilled and proactive Electrical Engineer to support the maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and installation of electrical, automation, and instrumentation systems within our processing operations.
	The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience maintaining industrial electrical equipment and possess strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.


Key Responsibilities


	Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance, diagnosis, and repair of electrical, automation, and instrumentation equipment, including industrial motor controls and pump drives.
	Troubleshoot and repair faulty electrical equipment, appliances, machinery, and control systems.
	Diagnose electrical faults down to component level to extend equipment lifespan and reduce maintenance costs.
	Perform maintenance, installation, repair, and troubleshooting of control centres, high-voltage equipment, and high-voltage motors.
	Maintain engine generators and associated control circuit equipment.
	Install, maintain, and repair building electrical circuits and related equipment.
	Maintain and troubleshoot alarm systems, VFDs, soft starters, pneumatic and electronic controls, and programmable control systems.
	Conduct thermographic inspections of electrical distribution panels and motor control systems.


Requirements


	Diploma or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering.
	1 - 5 years of relevant experience in electrical maintenance, preferably within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
	Strong knowledge of electrical machinery, equipment, and electronic control systems.
	Ability to troubleshoot and carry out electrical maintenance across different types and models of machines.

N160,000 - N200,000 monthly.

The story started in 1988, with the opening of a small supermarket store measuring 120 m2 in Lagos under the Park ’n’ Shop banner. Today, its business spreads from retail to real estate, shopping malls and manufacturing, rightly gaining popularity as Artee Group.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Outlet Concept Manager - Home Meal Replacement
Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full Time
     

            
    



Key Responsibilities
Sales, Margin & Product Mix:


	Own sales and gross margin performance across HMR, Bakery and Butchery.
	Analyse sales trends, product contribution, waste and customer preferences to improve range and production plans.
	Execute promotions, seasonal offers and new product initiatives within approved guidelines.
	Ensure pricing and portioning support both customer value and profitability.


Food Safety, Quality & Freshness:


	Maintain strict compliance with approved food safety, hygiene and quality standards, including HACCP requirements and applicable regulations.
	Conduct daily checks on raw materials, production, storage temperatures, display conditions, labelling and shelf life.
	Ensure FIFO/FEFO and freshness controls are consistently applied.
	Investigate quality complaints and prevent recurrence.


Production, Yield, Waste & Inventory:


	Plan production with demand to maximise availability while minimising overproduction and spoilage.
	Monitor ingredient/product usage, yields, wastage, damages and production variances.
	Coordinate replenishment with Buying, Supply Chain, Receiving and central kitchen/vendor partners.
	Ensure equipment and production areas are fit for purpose and safely operated.


Customer Experience & Concept Activation:


	Maintain clean, attractive and well-presented counters and displays.
	Use tastings, demonstrations and other approved engagement activities to drive trial and sales.
	Resolve escalated complaints and ensure timely service recovery.


People Leadership & Capability:


	Lead supervisors, chefs, bakers, butchers and customer-facing teams.
	Set clear production, sales, service and hygiene expectations and coach performance.
	Deploy manpower to demand and production requirements and build technical capability.


Compliance, Risk & Reporting:


	Maintain audit readiness for food safety, hygiene, health and safety and operational controls.
	Review daily performance and drive closure of quality, waste, stock and service exceptions.
	Submit concise reports on sales, margin, availability, waste, quality and actions.


Education and Years of Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree / HND in Food Science, Hospitality, Culinary/Food Technology, Business Administration or related field.
	3–5+ years in food retail, restaurant, bakery, butchery or fresh food operations, including supervisory/management experience.


Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:


	Food retail operations
	Food safety/HACCP
	Production planning and yield control
	Commercial and margin awareness
	Inventory/waste control
	People leadership
	Excel/reporting


Salary
N300,000 - N400,000 / month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

title: Job Openings at MartGlobal Limited
content:
MartGlobal Limited is a leading manufacturing company dedicated to producing high quality packaging polythene products that meet industry standards and customer requirements.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Quality Control Officer

Job Location: Lagos

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Conduct incoming, in-process, and final product inspections.
	Ensure products conform to approved specifications and quality standards.
	Inspect dimensions,finishing, and overall product quality.
	Identify and document non-conforming products and materials.
	Prepare inspection and quality reports.
	Work with Production and Engineering teams to resolve quality issues.
	Monitor corrective and preventive actions.
	Maintain accurate quality records and documentation.
	Support internal and external quality audits.
	Ensure compliance with the company’s QMS requirements.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor`s Degree and must have requisite experience with a Polythene Company. 


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: Candidates must have requisite experience with a Polythene Company.

 

2.) Driver

Job Location: Akowonjo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Safely drive company staff and executives to assigned locations.
	Maintain and keep the company vehicle clean and in good condition.
	Carry out routine vehicle checks and report faults promptly.
	Ensure proper loading and safe delivery of materials to sites.
	Comply with traffic laws and company policies.
	Run official errands and perform other duties assigned by management.


Requirements


	HND, NCE, or OND with 2–3 years of driving experience.
	Valid Nigerian Driver’s Licence.
	Good knowledge of major roads and surrounding areas.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: You must live around Akowonjo environs.

 

 

3.) Operations Supervisor

Job Location: Iyana-Ipaja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Operations Supervisor to coordinate the company's general operational activities, ensuring that facilities, utilities, equipment, materials and support services are properly managed and available for smooth business operations.
	The ideal candidate should have a technical background or strong experience in electrical/electronic equipment, industrial components, machinery spare parts, utilities, facilitiesor a related environment, with good administrative, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.


Responsibilities


	Coordinate the company's day-to-day general operational activities and support services.
	Monitor and coordinate the effective management of utilities and facility-related services, including power supply, water, generator, air-conditioning, lighting, plumbing, and other essential services.
	Monitor the condition and functionality of company facilities, equipment, tools, and operational assets.
	Identify facility, utility, and equipment-related issues and ensure they are promptly reported and followed through to resolution.
	Liase with maintenance personnel and service providers on repairs, servicing, installations and general facility maintenance.
	Receive, review, coordinate and process spare parts and maintenance item requests from relevant departments.
	Ensure that spare-part requests are properly documented, approved, issuedand tracked.
	Liaise with the Stores/Procurement and Maintenance teams to ensure availability of critical spare parts, tools, equipment, and operational materials.
	Maintain proper records of spare parts, equipment, tools, maintenance requests, utility usageand facility-related activities.
	Monitor the usage, movement, and accountability of company equipment, tools, and operational assets.
	Follow up on outstanding maintenance, facility, utilityand operational requests until completion.
	Coordinate external technicians, contractors, vendors, and service providers when required.
	Assist in evaluating technical requirements and verifying that supplied electrical/electronic components, equipmentand spare parts meet requested specifications.
	Ensure proper documentation of equipment breakdowns, repairs, replacements, servicing, and maintenance activities.
	Monitor the company's general operational environment and escalate issues that may affect business continuity.
	Assist management in identifying operational inefficiencies and recommending practical solutions.
	Ensure compliance with company procedures, operational controls, safety requirements and applicable standards.
	Perform other operational and coordination duties as assigned by management.


Requirements


	HND or B.Sc. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management, Operations Managementor a related discipline.
	Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in operations, facilities, utilities, maintenance coordination, technical support, spare-parts managementor a related environment.
	Experience in a manufacturing, engineering, industrial, electrical/electronics, or technical environment is highly desirable.
	Strong practical knowledge of electrical/electronic equipment, components, industrial machinery spare parts, tools, and related technical materials.
	Ability to understand basic technical specifications and identify/verify electrical and electronic components and spare parts.
	Experience coordinating facility maintenance, utilities, repairs, service providers, and contractors.
	Good understanding of inventory/spare-parts request, issuance, tracking, and documentation processes.
	Strong administrative, organizational, and coordination skills
	Proximity to the work location is key.


Salary
N200,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using Operations Supervisor as the subject of the email.    

    

        Click here to Apply
